versions.changelog:
- Added an "安装方法 / Installation" section in SKILL.md, including instructions for installation via ClawHub, OpenClaw CLI, and manual steps.
- Listed system requirements and required R packages in the documentation.
- No code or interface changes; update is documentation-only.

v4.0.0 is a major update adding Chinese language report generation and associated enhancements.

- Added automatic generation of comprehensive Chinese analysis reports for all workflows.
- Updated descriptions, folder names, and report sections to support both Chinese and English, with a focus on Chinese as default for outputs and documentation.
- Expanded triggers to include the new keyword “生成报告”.
- Revised documentation to clearly explain the new Chinese report features and workflow.
- Maintained all auto-organization and script generation functions from previous versions.

**BioinfoAI-Assistant v3.0.0 introduces intelligent auto-organization to all outputs and a refined, fully structured analysis workflow.**

- New project folder system: All scripts, plots, tables, reports, R objects, logs, and reproducibility files are auto-organized into standardized subfolders.
- Every file from scripts to figures and results is saved in a pre-defined location; no more manual sorting.
- Expanded supported file/folder triggers for more seamless analysis start.
- Workflow and documentation streamlined to emphasize "analyze once, organize forever."
- All outputs tracked as they are generated, with auto-repair and re-organization if analysis errors occur.
- Updated name, description, and metadata to reflect broad auto-organization and clear author/institution information.

**Major upgrade: Transformed into an AI-powered bioinformatics analysis platform.**

- Auto-detects sequencing data type, species, and data quality.
- Recommends optimal analysis strategies and pipeline workflows using AI.
- Automatically generates structured project folders and customized R scripts with documentation.
- Opens scripts in RStudio with real-time monitoring and output tracking.
- Includes intelligent error detection and auto-correction for seamless execution.
- Broadened trigger support to include sequencing data files and specialized bioinformatics keywords.

- Added 赵净洁 as co-author, including contact information in documentation
- Updated author sections and acknowledgments in SKILL.md to reflect co-authorship
- No functional changes to skill triggers or core usage

- Added author’s name and contact details (including institution and email) in English and Chinese.
- Expanded documentation with installation instructions, detailed usage examples, pane descriptions, and support contact.
- Clarified supported languages (English and Chinese) for commands and auto-activation.
- Improved instructions for common workflows and execution steps in RStudio.
- Refined formatting and organization for readability.

Initial release of rstudio-runner.

- Launch and open .R or .Rmd files directly in RStudio with one click.
- Supports interactive script execution, step-by-step monitoring, and plotting in the RStudio GUI.
- Auto-activates on upload of R scripts or trigger keywords in English and Chinese.
- Designed for hands-on visual analysis, debugging, and plotting within RStudio, especially for HCC scRNA-seq workflows.
